CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(Confident_From__c), "",
IF(HOUR(Confident_From__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Confident_From__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Confident_From__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Confident_From__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Confident_From__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Confident_From__c))) &
IF (HOUR(Confident_From__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Confident from Formula
